batteryNotes:
CAN YOU GET 6-9 HOURS FROM 80% TO 20%?
Not established for any listed model under your exact workload.
80% to 20% uses 60% of nominal usable capacity; 100% to 20% uses 80%.
Six hours requires average drain <=10 percentage points/hour; nine hours <=6.67.
A 6000mAh phone at 80%-20% offers roughly 3600mAh of nominal charge budget,
before aging and conversion losses. Battery size alone cannot predict runtime.
My judgment: 6-9 hours elapsed time with intermittent camera/navigation may be
possible; 6-9 hours of sustained bright-screen navigation, active hotspot traffic
and frequent photo/video capture is not a dependable purchase assumption.
GPS merely enabled differs greatly from active navigation. Hotspot traffic,
weak mobile signal, outdoor brightness, heat, dual SIM and video change drain.
Published video-playback or mixed-use claims do not test your simultaneous load.
A used battery also reduces available energy; health percentage is only one clue.
Test your own SIM, carrier and workload. Consider a brief wired top-up or power
bank for demanding days rather than rejecting a good phone over an unproven target.
